_README: Selectors for the PPC sync agent's REI BlackBook crawler (read only). login.* and list.* reuse selectors that were verified live in this account by the Level 10 app (config/reibb.selectors.json: contacts.searchInput, contacts.resultRow, contacts.openContact). Every detail.labels value is the visible label text on a contact page; labels marked in _verify still need to be checked against your account (run: npm run ppc:rei-login, open one contact, compare the labels). If REI renames a label or changes its layout, the crawler stops that field, reports the exact step and selector in Data health, and keeps the last good data; REI CSV exports remain the safe fallback. Selector syntax: one Playwright selector per value; a comma list must be CSS only (Playwright's :has-text(), :text-is() and :text-matches() are fine inside it), never mixed with text= or xpath=.

login.submitButton: button[type='submit'], button:has-text('Log In'), button:has-text('Login'), button:has-text('Sign In'), input[type='submit']

blockers.captcha: iframe[src*='recaptcha'], iframe[src*='hcaptcha'], iframe[title*='challenge' i], .g-recaptcha, #challenge-form, :text-matches('verify you are human', 'i')

list.pageMarker: input[placeholder*='Search By Name' i], input[placeholder*='Search by name' i], input[placeholder*='Name, Phone' i], input[placeholder*='Search' i], input[type='search']
list.nextPage: a[aria-label*='next' i], button[aria-label*='next' i]:not([disabled]), button:has-text('Next'):not([disabled]), a:has-text('Next')
